notification.title: Notification center
notification.description: Things waiting for you and changes to your account show up here. Read notifications are removed after the retention period.

message.webhookDisabled_one: Webhook "{{name}}" failed {{count}} time in a row and was turned off
message.webhookDisabled_other: Webhook "{{name}}" failed {{count}} times in a row and was turned off
message.approvalPendingStep: {{requester}}'s {{type}} request reached "{{step}}" and is waiting for your review
message.approvalUnassigned: "{{step}}" of a {{type}} request has no (or too few) reviewers and needs attention
message.commentMentioned: Mentioned you in a comment on {{resourceType}} “{{name}}”

detail.subject: {{subject}}
detail.dataTransferError: Something went wrong. See My imports & exports for details

event.description: The system notifies the people involved when these events happen. Turning a channel off stops future deliveries; notifications already sent are kept, and turning it back on does not resend them.
event.mandatory: Security related, cannot be turned off

approvalPending.name: Request awaiting review
approvalPending.description: Notifies reviewers when someone submits a request or a multi-step request reaches their step.
approvalPending.recipients: Single step: people with "Review requests" at submission (except the requester); multi-step: the reviewers of that step

approvalResult.name: Request reviewed
approvalResult.description: Notifies the requester when a request is approved or rejected. Email is the existing review result email.

userRolesChanged.name: Roles changed
userRolesChanged.description: Notifies a user when roles are assigned to or removed from them.

webhookDisabled.name: Webhook turned off
webhookDisabled.description: Sent when a webhook is turned off after failing to deliver too many times in a row.
webhookDisabled.recipients: Everyone who can edit webhooks at that moment

announcementPublished.name: Announcements
announcementPublished.description: Announcements sent by admins, now or on a schedule. Open the notification to read the full text.

approvalProgress.name: Request progress
approvalProgress.description: Notifies the requester when a multi-step request passes a step.

approvalUnassigned.name: No reviewers for an approval step
approvalUnassigned.description: A step of a multi-step request found no (or too few) reviewers by its rule.

commentMentioned.name: Mentioned in a comment
commentMentioned.description: Notifies you when someone mentions you in a comment.
commentMentioned.recipients: Mentioned people who can see the item

commentCreated.name: New comment on a watched item
commentCreated.description: Notifies you of new comments on items you watch (commenters watch automatically).
commentCreated.recipients: Watchers (except the commenter and people already mentioned)

watchResourceUpdated.name: Watched item changed
watchResourceUpdated.description: Notifies you when an item you watch is changed; at most once a minute per item.
watchResourceUpdated.recipients: Watchers (except the person who made the change)

dataTransferExportFinished.name: Export finished
dataTransferExportFinished.description: Sent when an export finishes or fails; open it to download the file from My imports & exports.
dataTransferExportFinished.recipients: The person who started the export

dataTransferImportFinished.name: Import finished
dataTransferImportFinished.description: Sent when applying an import finishes or fails, with the succeeded, failed, and skipped counts.
dataTransferImportFinished.recipients: The person who started the import

preference.title: Notifications
preference.description: Choose which notifications you receive. Items turned off or required by your administrator cannot be changed.

lock.mandatory: Security related, cannot be turned off

overview.title: Notification overview
overview.description: In-app notifications received by everyone in this tenant. Content is shown as the recipient sees it; read notifications past the retention period are removed automatically.
